summary: SUP-1008 (Shakti Components Pvt Ltd) has a 48-hour factory outage starting 2026-12-02. Two open POs for ITM-501 fall due before it ends - PO-1001 (4000 units, due 2026-12-03) and PO-1002 (2500 units, due 2026-12-04) - with INR 491400.00 exposed. DC-PUNE stock of ITM-501 covers 1.5 days, which is less than the expected delay, so both POs are expected to cause a shortage. SUP-1008's remaining capacity and restart date are unknown.
facts: The event reports a 48-hour factory outage at SUP-1008.
PO-1001 orders 4000 units of ITM-501, due 2026-12-03.
PO-1002 orders 2500 units of ITM-501, due 2026-12-04.
DC-PUNE holds 1100 units of ITM-501 on hand.
Total exposure on the affected POs is INR 491400.00.

estimates.basis: impact.estimated_delay_days for PO-1001, derived from the outage duration

estimates.statement: DC-PUNE runs short of ITM-501 before PO-1001 can arrive.
estimates.basis: impact.inventory_coverage_days for PO-1001 is less than its delay; impact.shortage is true

estimates.statement: PO-1002 arrives 1 day late into a stock that PO-1001's gap has already used up, so it adds to the shortage.

assumptions: The outage duration reported in the event is accurate.
Open POs due after the outage ends are not delayed by it.
